The post Mexican National Admits to Laundering $4,000,000 Worth of US Drug Trafficking Proceeds via Crypto appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A Mexican national has pleaded guilty to laundering $4 million in drug trafficking proceeds using cryptocurrency. According to the U.S. Department of Justice, the individual earned $40,000 by working with money brokers to collect drug profits from various cities. The defendant now faces up to twenty years in prison for his role in the international money laundering scheme.
